subject.title: Feature: Telegram Reactions - Two-Way Support with Prompt Guidance

question: Should incoming Telegram reactions influence agent prompt behavior through the existing `reactionLevel` contract, a renamed replacement, or a separate `reactionGuidance` setting?
rationale: Current main already uses `reactionLevel` as the public prompt and capability control, so choosing another setting would add overlapping config and compatibility semantics that source inspection cannot resolve.

options.title: Extend reactionLevel
options.body: Keep one canonical config source, add optional incoming soft-signal guidance to minimal and extensive modes, and gate it on enabled accepted-reaction notifications.

options.title: Add reactionGuidance
options.body: Add a separate prompt-only setting only after defining exact precedence and migration behavior against `reactionLevel` and `reactionNotifications`.

options.title: Keep events neutral
options.body: Retain outbound guidance and incoming system events without prescribing emoji interpretations in the system prompt.

recommendation.title: Extend reactionLevel
recommendation.body: Keep one canonical config source, add optional incoming soft-signal guidance to minimal and extensive modes, and gate it on enabled accepted-reaction notifications.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available recent history across the affected Telegram, config, and prompt surfaces and already participated in this issue's product triage.
